state.ai_page_guidance:
GENERAL TRANSCRIPTION RULES:
- Keep one printed line per Markdown line.
- Rejoin end-of-line hyphenated words without mid-word breaks.

PAGE LAYOUT AND HEADERS:
- Follow the header patterns strictly based on page parity:
- @Header_Pari / @Testata_Pari (Even pages): Page number on the left, book title on the right.
- @Header_dispari / @Testata_Dispari (Odd pages): Chapter title on the left, page number on the right.

HEADINGS AND CONTENT STRUCTURE:
- @Capitolo_(#): This is the highest level of heading. These are listed in the ToC.
- @Sezione_(##): Content separation related to historical phases. Section titles must be centered in the page (do not left-align them like boxes).
- Note for @Box_Curiosità_Sandwitch: Do not confuse a @Sezione_(##) sandwiched between two boxes with a box itself. A section is identified by being centered and having lines above and below it, whereas Box titles are ALL CAPS and left-aligned.

CURIOSITY BOXES (@Box_Curiosità):
- Format all curiosity boxes as an aside block using curly braces: { [content] }. Do not format them as headings or blockquotes.
- Layout: The title is in ALL CAPS above the content; the box is a rectangular area with black borders, as wide as the normal text column. Box titles are left-aligned.
- @doppia_Box_Curiosità: Two separate boxes stacked one above the other.
- @Tripla_Box_curiosità: Three boxes stacked.
- @Box_Curiosità_wIMG_connessa: The image at the top must be considered internal to the curiosity box below (even if they appear as two separate widgets).
- @Box_Curiosità_con_Tabella: For these sections, create a Markdown table for the content.

IMAGES AND DECORATIONS:
- @Immagine_part-page_full_width: Include the caption in italics directly below the image.
- @immagine_part-page_part_width: 
    - On even pages (Pari): Image is left-aligned, caption is in italics on the right.
    - On odd pages (Dispari): Image is left-aligned, caption is in italics on the left.
- @Immagine_Full_Page: Include the caption below.
- @Immagine
